conditional_contract.facts: A structurally reached supported MAudioEvent/PAudioClip and one verified AudioCluster segment, known source bounds/rate/layout and actual matching attached media. The first admitted timing subset is typed10 with the bound zero source coordinate; no string-name attribution.

Use the explicit renderer-selection predicates: unmuted event, finite positive event volume, empty numeric event attrs/volume curve, no inversion/fades/neighbors, TransposeLock1, no Warpscale/Bypass/Pitch/replacement content. Restrict counted clip children to the supported plain26-byte MHitPointEvent v3 source subset; reject arbitrary children or serialized NoteEvent/MicroPitchChangeFactors. Packed no-pitch state remains an explicit fresh reconstruction/call-time assumption, not an implication of absent serialized names. No external pitch context or later state mutation is admitted.

Both pinned LoFi and Classic source trees contain null local track setting and nonnull project MAutoFadeSetting v0 flags0. The sealed ownership finding identifies that same MRoot as the normal fallback receiver. The builder therefore takes its effective-flags0 automatic-fade bypass. Four serialized interpolator bodies remain opaque and unused on this branch. Classic still fails other admission predicates, notably Warpscale; this gate does not make Classic renderable.

Normal remainder builds concrete PAudioSegment with stream+38, start+50, nonnegative end-minus-start length+58, source offset+60 and Float32 gain+68. Datum conversion and sign-selected ±0.5 then FCVTZS occur in construction. For the nonnegative converted source offset/length at the inner reader, seek=FCVTZS(offsetFrames+0.5) and count=FCVTZS(lengthFrames+0.5). Require representable positive count and a complete source interval.

Conditioned on an already selected PAudioSegment/AudioStream clone,10018fb40 inner path seeks, requests min(remaining,10000), and consumes returnedFrames. Nonunity gain applies exactly one Float32 FMUL per returned frame×channel element (vector groups then scalar tail); unity skips arithmetic. No mix, clipping, ramp or FMA occurs in this loop. Under successful full reads/writes emitted source indices are [seek,seek+count), with no extra endpoint sample. Short reads, errors, cancellation and general output-writer encoding are excluded.

Declare native little-endian Float32 output format5 even at unity event gain. For the separate admitted packed signed24 conversion, require equal finite positive source/output rate, same positive channel count and supported interleaved layout, exact converter gain1, safe signed sample/byte counts and adequate disjoint buffers. Decode signed p then x=Float32(p/8388608), exactly representable. Event gain is a separate subsequent operation, never folded into converter gain.

For the admitted positive finite-normal event gain and nearest-even FP mode, y=x when gain equals1, otherwise y=RN32(x*g). Require normal-or-zero finite products; reject nonfinite/overflow/underflow/subnormal domains in a conservative reconstruction. Native loop itself has no corresponding safety clamp or finite guard. No generic sample-rate conversion is substituted.
